openings.claim: Manifest-stage-order paired input/output-digest bracketing may locate earliest supported divergence, replacing local timestamp ordering.
openings.discriminator: Timestamp-first mismatch-review rival: anomalous export time changes its chronology, not manifest brackets. Missing transform digests/removed records widen uncertainty, never establish nonexecution.
openings.probe: Align manifest identifiers in spreadsheet/script; log at most twelve inspections/pair. Across six pairs separate observed mismatches/explanations, cite supplied records for definite stages, report earliest supported stage/unresolved interval and next supplied-record check. Freeze outputs before answer sheets.
openings.uncertainty: Expected order is not execution proof. Unverified correspondence/unavailable intervening boundaries require unresolved intervals. Defeat: excluded injected boundary, recordless definite stage claim, or exceeded inspection/time capacity. No measured advantage.

openings.claim: Uncertainty feedback may redirect inspections: ledger requests check → request selects supplied-record inspection → result updates decision ledger; replace fixed manifest queue.
openings.discriminator: Rival: fixed queue with final evidence collation. Feedback could narrow supported intervals at equal inspection counts; equal intervals and check choices show no detected return influence.
openings.probe: Compare disjoint three-pair subsets within twenty additional minutes; equal initial demand: one uncertain-boundary check/pair. Sham removes result→decision-ledger updating, retains final claim collation/valued outcome. Freeze reports before comparing answer sheets, intervals and inspection logs.
openings.uncertainty: Return influence is unsupported/hypothetical. Defeat: unsupported certainty or exceeding twelve inspections/pair. Subset differences confound comparison; this small probe establishes no causal advantage.

lineage.reason: Bracketing relation, rival, limits and uncertainties preserved.
Feedback relation, sham comparison, defeat and confounding preserved.

decision: Retain both exploratory hypotheses separately; both obey reporting/evidence limits. Use sixty analyst minutes plus twenty comparison minutes. Final disturbance randomly removes one transform record from each of two pairs, manifests unchanged. Missing evidence remains unresolved; no demonstrated performance.
